rounds.text: Conceded: [E35]. Despite apparent statistical cheapness, the business is fundamentally compromised by severe cash flow destruction, with operating cash flow collapsing to negative Rs 3.87 Cr and free cash flow reaching negative Rs 4.31 Cr in Mar 2026 [E27, E28]. This deterioration is further underscored by a dismal cash conversion ratio of negative 2.51x against reported profit, alongside operating cash flow plunging to -126% of operating profit [E26, E29]. Conceded: [E12]. Profitability quality is rapidly deteriorating as evidenced by a trailing twelve-month profit growth of -14%, contrasting sharply with historical figures [E17]. Operating margins are persistently contracting, falling 11 percentage points over three years to 18% in Mar 2026 alongside a decreasing four-year trend [E22, E24]. Working capital management is deeply problematic, highlighted by extraordinarily high debtors stretching to 393 days [E52]. Conceded: [E30]. Concurrently, debt obligations are escalating rapidly with borrowings surging nearly four and a half times to Rs 5.27 Cr in Mar 2026 from Rs 1.17 Cr a year prior [E31]. Market sentiment matches these deteriorating fundamentals completely, as the stock languishes 52.5% below its 52-week high, trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, and suffers from a zero relative-strength rating against the Nifty 500 [E39, E40, E41].
